title: Potato: modeled ₹712/qtl left, Kayamkulam → Vandiperiyar
summary: May 2025: reported potato prices at Kayamkulam and Vandiperiyar imply a positive modeled margin after costs on 97% of 30 matched days; a morning-report back-test averages ₹712 per quintal. No actual trade verified.
why_selected: Selected from 1,610 same-variety market pairs screened for potato in May 2025; best tested candidate among the bounded set of routed finalists, not a global optimum.

evidence.observations: daily modal prices for the same variety and grade (FAQ) at both markets; sale matched to the first Vandiperiyar report 1–3 days after purchase
caveats: Back-test on reported prices: no actual shipment, buyer or seller is claimed.
Modal prices are reported daily aggregates, not offers anyone could be sure to get.
This data has no arrival volumes, so it cannot show whether the destination could absorb more supply; no capital-constrained or volume allocation optimum is claimed.

Costs extrapolate onion survey values (including to other crops) plus stated allowances, not freight quotes; OSRM car routing, not a verified truck route. Representative town points may not be at mandi gates.
Historical: this says what paid then, not what pays today.

scenes.headline: May 2025
scenes.caption: Kayamkulam (Kerala) and Vandiperiyar (Kerala) both reported potato prices for the same variety and grade (FAQ) on 30 matched days.

scenes.headline: Two markets, two prices
scenes.caption: Kayamkulam reported a median ₹2,500 per quintal. Vandiperiyar reported a median ₹3,600 around modeled arrival days. These are not offers.

scenes.headline: Gap ₹1,100/qtl
scenes.caption: The median gap was ₹1,100 per quintal, and Vandiperiyar was dearer on 100% of days.

scenes.headline: 124 km by road
scenes.caption: 124 km on OpenStreetMap roads (~2 hours by car). A loaded truck is slower, so we allow 1 days plus 7 days to get paid.

scenes.headline: After modeled costs
scenes.caption: Freight ≈₹27/qtl, 5% fees and commission, loading, 5% loss and interest. On the typical day ₹752 per quintal was left.

scenes.headline: Still positive under stress
scenes.caption: With 25% dearer freight, 10% loss and costlier credit, the typical day still kept ₹565 per quintal.

scenes.headline: A trader who only knew the morning's news
scenes.caption: Using only the latest available Vandiperiyar report, the rule selects 29 of 30 modeled shipping days. 28 had positive modeled net, averaging ₹712 per quintal (₹524 under stress).

scenes.headline: The back-test
scenes.caption: The modeled Potato route from Kayamkulam to Vandiperiyar was positive on 97% of matched days in May 2025. At that average, a 100-quintal (10-tonne) load implies ₹71,200, or ₹52,400 under stress. Actual buyer, capacity, haggling, rejection and delays are unknown.

assumptions.value: onion survey freight applied per quintal to potato
scaled by road km against the 1,115 km Lasalgaon→Azadpur route → ₹27/qtl here
12% a year (14% adverse) for transit + 7 days
~450 road km a day → 1 days here

conclusion: The modeled Potato route from Kayamkulam to Vandiperiyar was positive on 97% of matched days in May 2025. At that average, a 100-quintal (10-tonne) load implies ₹71,200, or ₹52,400 under stress. Actual buyer, capacity, haggling, rejection and delays are unknown.
